title: Reeb spaces of functions being analytic on dense subsets and their graph structures
summary: Reeb spaces of real-valued functions on manifolds are the spaces of all connected components (contours) of level sets and endowed with the natural quotient topology. They have been fundamental and strong tools in investigating manifolds via smooth functions with mild critical points since the birth of fundamental theory of Morse functions in the 20th century. We are concerned with topologies and combinatorics of them.
